title: Openverse stock track search
what_it_does: Searches Openverse for a CC0 or CC BY track that fits a mood and length, downloads it and writes the attribution line the video needs.
when_to_use: Only when the person asks for a real recorded track. It cannot follow the cuts, so the scorer stays the default; a CC BY track always needs its credit shown.
notes: The licence field is for our code. The tracks it finds are CC0 or CC BY, and CC BY needs attribution (creditFor builds it). Needs network; that is why it is opt-in with --source openverse. Builtin: a command of this CLI; add only records it in the studio.
